address: Subida al Frontón 46, Santa Cruz de Campezo, 01110, Spain
bio: When you drive through small villages such as this one, what you least expect to find is a restaurant like ARREA!, where owner-chef Edorta Lamo takes guests on a fascinating cultural and gastronomic journey through the almost subsistence-like landscapes of the Montaña Alavesa region, albeit from a more contemporary perspective. Its three highly distinct dining spaces also come as a surprise, comprising the Taberna (the waiting area), the Kuadra (only offering the Mendialdea menu, featuring five market-inspired dishes and the traditional “putxero” stew), and the main dining room, with its homely rustic ambience, dedicated exclusively to the gastronomic menu.
